items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him at the Atlanta Jazz Festival.

ctx.x: Yeah. I worked with Avery when he did Malcolm X, with Anthony Davis in that opera. He knows music. He knows it. He loves this music.
I met him at the Atlanta Jazz Festival. That was a long time ago.
Delroy, I’ve worked with him as well. He seems to work a lot down in Washington.
